filament_notes:
CC3D TPU 98A 340M, skin color, 1.75mm. Bambu Lab H2S (DIRECT DRIVE).

Vendor sheet: nozzle 195-215C, bed 0-60C.
Run from the EXTERNAL spool holder, not AMS 2 Pro. Do not heat the chamber.

=== PENDING - fill in after physical calibration ===
nozzle_temperature            215   PENDING  <- temp tower 200-235C / 5C steps (transfers from Ender)
filament_flow_ratio           1.0   PENDING  <- flow pass1 then pass2
filament_max_volumetric_speed 7.5   PENDING  <- expect 8-12 mm3/s; 7.5 matches the
                                              Bambu Studio preset so the two slicers
                                              stay comparable. Still not measured.
filament_retraction_length    0.4   PENDING  <- retraction tower, expect 0.4-0.8mm
pressure advance                    AUTO     <- H2S self-calibrates PA, leave it alone

Values above are generic/vendor starting points, NOT measured. Do not trust
estimates from these until the PENDING lines are replaced with real numbers.

filament_density 1.21 g/cm3 is the generic polyester-TPU figure, not a CC3D
published spec. It only scales the 'filament used [g]' estimate. Weigh a
printed part and correct it if the gram numbers matter to you.
filament_cost 25 is a placeholder - set your actual spool price.
